newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end sharply lower amid trader protest.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end sharply lower amid trader protest.

text.p: Dhaka stocks slid for a seventh straight session amid a noisy demonstration by traders in the kerb market, brokers said.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) closed 114.47 points or 5.68 percent down at 1900.63 on a turnover of 43.4 million taka. Of 81 traded issues, 78 lost, one gained and two unchanged.

Trading suffered as police with batons charged traders protesting the ongoing fall in prices outside the DSE floor. Brokers said the bearishness could continue throughout the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.
Apex Foods lost 1,451 taka to 13,071 and Beximco Pharma shed 21 to 209.
